verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API v2 documents the core agent loop. It has slot availability queries, including by username and event slug, a public booking-creation endpoint for agents, and a reschedule endpoint with slot-exclusion support. A hosted MCP server (mcp.cal.com) lets AI clients manage bookings through natural language. Cancellation is not explicitly documented as an API endpoint or MCP tool; it appears only as a BOOKING_CANCELLED webhook trigger and under the generic phrase "manage bookings". missing for 10: an explicitly documented cancel-booking endpoint or MCP tool, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can check availability, book, reschedule, and cancel meetings end to end through the API or MCP — no dashboard needed
